title: Ukraine’s Campaign against Russian Naval Assets Far Beyond the Black Sea Enters a new Phase
big: 1 new story. The top five are mostly about ships and submarines.

stories.h: Ukraine’s Campaign Against Russian Naval Assets Far Beyond The Black Sea Enters A New Phase
stories.what: A Russian Navy corvette burned and capsized after being struck by Ukrainian uncrewed service vessels (USVs) while docked in Benghazi, Libya. In addition, a Russian cargo ship was struck by Ukrainian USVs while operating off Benghazi in the Mediterranean.
